result.summary: Deletes the obsolete `indexes/coinstats` database directory automatically on startup when `-coinstatsindex` is enabled. The old directory was left intact in v30 to allow nodes to downgrade to v29 without having to rebuild the index. With v29 reaching end-of-life, the database is now destroyed and removed if found.
result.problem: Nodes upgraded from v29 or earlier retain the legacy `indexes/coinstats` directory indefinitely unless manually deleted, wasting disk space even though the active index resides in `indexes/coinstatsindex`.
evidence: A code comment in `coinstatsindex.cpp` scheduled this cleanup: '// TODO: Change this to deleting the old index with v31.'

PR description: 'coinstatsindex was updated in an incompatible way in v30 (see #30469) and moved to the indexes/coinstatsindex folder... Since v32 branch-off has happened, this would now ship in v33. By then 29.x should be EOL assuming we are not going to release a v29.5.'
result.card: Automatically deletes the obsolete legacy coinstats index directory at indexes/coinstats on startup when -coinstatsindex is enabled. A format migration in v30 moved the active index to indexes/coinstatsindex while retaining the old folder to support downgrades to v29. With v29 reaching end-of-life, this scheduled cleanup reclaims disk space for users who had upgraded from older releases.
